description: This file defines a comprehensive UI screen for app settings in an Android app, built with Jetpack Compose. It includes sections for device info, media permissions, notification management, data access, location, and preferences. The file manages permission requests, interacts with system settings, and provides UI controls for user configuration. It also includes utility functions for querying installed apps and checking device capabilities.

classes.name: InstalledApp
classes.description: Represents an installed application with label, package name, and system app flag.

methods.name: queryInstalledApps
methods.description: Retrieves a list of installed apps that are launchers or recently used, filtered by configured packages.

methods.name: resolveNotificationCandidatePackages
methods.description: Combines launcher, recent, and configured package lists to determine valid notification packages, excluding the app's own package.

methods.name: settingsTextFieldColors
methods.description: Provides color configuration for text fields used in settings UI.

methods.name: Modifier.settingsRowModifier
methods.description: Extension to style layout rows in the settings UI.

methods.name: settingsPrimaryButtonColors
methods.description: Provides color configuration for primary action buttons.

methods.name: settingsDangerButtonColors
methods.description: Provides color configuration for danger (destructive) action buttons.

methods.name: openAppSettings
methods.description: Opens the app's detail settings page in the system settings.

methods.name: openNotificationListenerSettings
methods.description: Opens the notification listener permission settings page.

methods.name: hasNotificationsPermission
methods.description: Checks if the app has notification posting permission, depending on SDK version.

methods.name: isNotificationListenerEnabled
methods.description: Checks if notification listener access is enabled.

methods.name: hasMotionCapabilities
methods.description: Determines if the device has motion sensors like accelerometer or step counter.

methods.name: isAssistantRoleAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the device supports the assistant role.

methods.name: isAssistantRoleHeld
methods.description: Checks if the current app holds the assistant role.
